correctness.rationale: For the finite complex span of normalized h1,h3, the exact lens transform reduces the mixed L_t^8 L_x^4 functional to the temporal constant term of the squared fourth spatial moment. Gaussian Hermite moments A,B,C,D,E were reconstructed independently in exact SymPy algebra; the resulting polynomial is 3(12288-11520s^2+8960s^3-2525s^4)/262144, derivative -15s(505s^2-1344s+1152)/65536. The quadratic has negative discriminant, proving the unique maximizing line and coefficient monotonicity on 0<=s<=1. Independent exact three-Hermite moment and Fourier extraction for real lambda reproduced the quartic factor -81|lambda-sqrt(30)/6|^2/512 and sextic coefficient -525/4096 at lambda0. The frozen CHECK.py, read as source not trusted as a certificate, explicitly works with formal complex lambda and conjugate ell; its exact coefficient assertions match the full complex formula. Remainders follow from the analytic rational, even expression. The result is restricted to the displayed finite band/curve, not a global odd-data sharp theorem.
